we present a new consensus protocol called Proof-of-Learning, that uses machine learning competitions to achieve consensus.
we present WekaCoin, which is a peer to peer currency that uses a consensus protocol based on machine learning competitions.

two problems: 1) how can we create a decentralized and verifiable database to store machine learning experiments and 2) how can we achieve consensus in a blockchain without the use of computationally intensive puzzles.

the Proof of Learning protocol is an innovative and novel way to achieve distributed consensus.

Proof of Learning has the potential to become a very efficient consensus mechanism for blockchain applications, but that there is a lot of work left before it can be used for a real application.

we are building a blockchain that is based on machine learning competitions and we use it to build a public distributed and verified database of state of art machine learning models.
we have developed a novel consensus mechanism based on machine learning and we have created a cryptocurrency based on this consensus mechanism.
we propose a new cryptocurrency that is based on a novel consensus algorithm that ranks the performance of machine learning models.

a blockchain can be used to build a public database of machine learning models and their results.
